notes.title: Coming Soon: AI Improvements, Cosmetic Options, Post Game Content
notes.content:
[h2]Turn Pass[/h2]

Hello seasoned duelists and fledgling card slingers alike, it's aeiou here. Hope you've had a nice December. Me? Well I've been doing my favorite thing - working on game content :)

It was a really cathartic experience returning to making content for Cardaire post launch. Things moved a bit faster now, and I was able to move with better purpose having seen a wider audience play and react to the game. You never really know what players will have strong positive OR negative reactions to until the game is in their hands.

I'm happy to announce I'll be releasing what I've dubbed the [b]"2.0 Update"[/b] quite soon. With this update I have two major goals:
[olist]
[*] Address the most popular piece of feedback I've gotten about the game (looking at you enemy AI)
[*] Add just a lil' bit more post game content
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121936/fc06da69a7be7e450e13df18668c2af9140c015b.png[/img]
(Art by [url=https://x.com/RamaWidjanarko2]Rama Widjanarko[/url])

[h2]What to Expect[/h2]

As much as I would love to make sweeping changes to the in-duel UI or deck editor, the hard truth is that those changes would require a game engine change and remaking the game from scratch. But with that in mind I wanted to do what I can to get the game in the current engine to be as good of an experience as possible.

The #1 thing I've seen mentioned as a requested change is improvement to the enemy AI, so that is the major issue I've taken on with this update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121936/fef38f2bde66cdd15609e54c5b366874a70f754d.png[/img]

So if [b]you promise[/b] to keep your expectations for the update realistic, here are some things that [b]I can promise[/b] will be in the update:

(did you promise? thank you, we make a good team you and I)

[list]
[*] Improvements to the enemy Duel AI that generally scale as you progress through the game
[*] Some unlockable cosmetics
[*] A new area that offers a bit of post game content for the thirstier grinders
[*] A handful of new Steam Achievements
[*] A few new music tracks
[*] A new (fishing!) minigame
[/list]

[h2]When to Expect It[/h2]

So when can you expect to get your hands on this fine update? Next year? Next Month?

*does a half hearted drum roll on my leg*

[b]January 17th![/b]

That's right, I'm planning on launching this thing in just about 2 weeks. If something really funky happens with playtesting I'll adjust accordingly, but that's the plan for now!

Here's just a tiny little preview image in the mean time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121936/13b2e625f52b6c7b2f891b6bf2572446e8483fff.png[/img]

[h2]In Other News...[/h2]

That's all I have for the time being Duelists. I'm going to skitter back to my dev cave and get back to work. Here's some other cool Cardaire stuff from the past couple weeks to hold you over.

- aeiou out!

[h3]I Need MORE Single Player Collectable Card Games![/h3]

Pan Gaming over on "the youtubes" posted an excellent video breaking down the magic of single player CCGs, with a focus on Cardaire (that's us!). I can't recommend the video enough, go check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I0DFS3r-NuE

[h3]Boss Collage[/h3]

One of our own card artists [url=https://bsky.app/profile/spacejamtwo.bsky.social]spacejamtwo (Victoria)[/url] sent me some outstanding art for the holidays that I can't help but share with how sweet it is. Check out those [strike]duelist pin machines[/strike] area bosses!

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/spacejamtwo.bsky.social][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121936/d29ebb104dca07af9e8441361286153ec54b91d4.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Future Plans and Launch Weekend Bug Roundup
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy pardners![/h1]

It's been a busy launch weekend. Pop was feeling quite generous when buying cards from the player at his card shop, paying as much as thousands of Card Shards for a few common cards. However I've been told Pop's learned his lesson now that his savings have been decimated, and will now pay a reasonable amount per card.

I wanted to take a moment to thank everyone who's been leaving feedback and reporting bugs on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3124080/discussions/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url]. It's helped me immensely to hunt down bugs and get patches shipped fast.

It was also an absolute joy watching players collaborate on card locations, deck strategies, and game knowledge on the forum as well. Genuinely there is nothing I enjoy more then seeing people interact with things I've made, so thank you from the bottom of my teeny tiny little heart.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

After a weekend of patching bugs, things are looking stable. I'm working on this game solo, so thank you for your patience while I bash bugs as they pop up. Bugs will always be my top priority, so I may shift back to them as they come up - but I wanted to lay out where my focus will be going forward otherwise.

[h3]QOL Updates[/h3]

I've already seen a few suggestions for QOL updates, so this will be my next major focus. Please continue to bring up things you would like to see, or give input on suggestions of others. It helps me know what to prioritize when I see an idea get more discussion.

I [b]absolutely cannot[/b] promise everything on this list will make it into game but a few popular suggestions on my radar are:
- More filters in the Deck Editor (Card type, set, etc.)
- Selling cards checking your deck as well as your bag
- Improvements to the enemy AI
- Steam Deck support (this may end up needing the trackpad of the Steam Deck to function)

[h3]DLC/Followup Game[/h3]

I think any indie dev could tell you about the pile of ideas that they had to cut before launch. I had to keep the scope of Cardaire as small as possible given my resources as a solo dev, but wanted to give a slice of the world I had envisioned. I'm proud of what I was able to make given my restrictions, but would love the chance to expand on it or make a proper longer sequel. 

The [b]number one thing[/b] that helps towards making a DLC or a full followup game a reality is Cardaire doing well, so I am going to continue to make it the best experience it can be for now.

[h2]Full Patch List[/h2]

I've always hated games who didn't post full patch notes, so I've commited to posting them with updates. These have been included in the minor update Steam announcements, but here is the full list since launch if you we're curious:

- Changed The Masked Duelist behavior so that he no longer soft locks the game if you duel him from behind
- Fixed a bug that was granting XP for selling cards (Sorry Mulligan, I know you were excited to train in swordsmanship but you will have to stick with dueling.)
- Fixed an issue where the VS screen was not removed after a tournament match.
-- If you have an issue with it blocking your hud, it should now clear if you re-enter Junction Hub
- Disabled sell option in store while troubleshooting further
- The collector now correctly hands out set rewards once
- Stellar Knight is now correctly given when opened in a booster pack
- Fixed a npc in Dusty Trail being marked with a duelist bubble
- The Collector should now more consistently be able to read how many special cards you have
- Fixed an issue with the special card hand outs
- Corrected the label for the Dusty Trail slot effect
- Fixed a bug that was causing cards to sell for quite a lot more then intended
- Re-activated the selling feature in Pop's Pop Up Card Swap Shop
- Re enabled selling cards to the shop (For real this time)
-- Selling should now be fixed, but please let me know on the forum if you are getting an unexpected number of cards
- Fixed a graphical error when the masked duelist hands out his card
- Fixed a minor typo on the Relaxed Duelist
- Hid some placeholder overworld sprites that were appearing in Junction Hub
- Further fixes to keep a blue box placeholder sprite from appearing on screen in some situations
- Minor text fixes in Frontier Wilds

[h2]In Other News...[/h2]

Ashmish made some STELLAR art featuring Mulligan and Stellar White. Check it out over on Bluesky or that other website.
